payload.text: The home-launch guard refuses a prompt whose session started under MOLT_AGT_DIR without starting in an agent home itself (the agents root, or any directory below a home such as work/), and names the home to launch from; a session started exactly in an agent home passes, as does one started anywhere else but $HOME. The guard tests CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, the directory the session started in, never the hook input's cwd, which follows Claude's cd. Project settings load from the start directory's .claude/ with no parent fallback, so a launch below the home would keep the contract and lose the fence.
